title: Scheduling resources, availability, requests, booking and attendance contract v1 (S7-S11; synthetic data only)

AvailabilityRequirement.description: One resource the window must occupy: a named resource, or any active resource of the kind at the location.

AvailabilitySearch.description: S9 query. Range is local dates in the location's zone, inclusive, at most 31 days (ADR 0009 S-S3-R3).

bufferMinutes.description: Free time required after the window on every required resource.

slotMinutes.description: Start granularity in real minutes from local midnight (default 15).

appointmentTypeCode.description: Recorded as a constraint; appointment-type rules are not modelled yet (see coverage).

advisory.description: A result is advisory; booking (S10) rechecks against the database constraint.

ResourceRefId.description: Opaque server-issued resource identifier. Never parse it.

TimeZone.description: IANA time zone name. The server also requires its zone database to know it.

Instant.description: RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset; stored and returned in UTC.

TimeBlockReason.description: Proposed reason vocabulary for unavailable time (not a practice decision).

NoOperatoryReason.description: Reserved exception vocabulary for an appointment that holds no operatory (S7). Proposed; starts with the observed no-show and cancellation cases. Never modelled as a resource.

AppointmentOperatoryAssignment.description: Booking-side shape (consumed by S10): an appointment holds zero or one operatory; holding none requires a typed reason.

Cursor.description: Opaque, tenant-bound, HMAC-protected. Never parse it.

effectiveUntil.description: Exclusive; the next version's effectiveFrom, or null when open-ended.

PatientRef.description: Opaque patient reference (same pattern as patient.schema.json PatientRef).

ReasonCode.description: Server-checked reason enumeration value; never free text.

RequestOrigin.description: Server-set surface the request came through; never caller input.

ContactConsent.description: Contact-consent state as recorded on the request; the consent decision itself belongs to E.

AppointmentRequestCreate.description: S8 request. Holds no resource and blocks no slot. Needs preferredWindows or flexibility (422 preferenceRequired).

AppointmentRequestClose.description: Close with a reason. `scheduled` requires appointmentRef (422 otherwise) and links both records; `expired` requires the configured expiryPolicyRef.

data.description: Requests that reached a terminal state without a booking (at most 100 listed; count is the total).

AdditionalResources.description: Equipment or staff the appointment also occupies (provider and operatory are separate fields).

OverrideCode.description: Proposed override vocabulary (not a practice decision).

BookingOverride.description: Authorized override of overrideable conflicts only (policy booking-override.pending-approval.1: outside_availability). Needs scheduling.override; resource overlap is never overrideable.

CancelReason.description: Proposed cancellation vocabulary (not a practice decision).

BookingCreate.description: S10 booking. Success is BookingResult outcome booked (201); conflicts are 409 with detail.conflicts filtered by visibility; denials are 403/404.

AppointmentReschedule.description: Books the new window and records the original as rescheduled with links both ways, in one transaction.

BookingResult.description: The successful BookingResult outcomes. conflict and denied are typed refusals (Refusal schema, 409/403/404), never 2xx.

AppointmentStatus.description: Booking lifecycle only. Attendance, clinical completion and billing are separate facts.
